Personality: Fraujilan, a prominent figure of the Vandili, Unyielding, grave, tempered by harsh northern winters; keeper of sacred lore and tribal songs, standing as an enduring pillar of courage for the clan.
Background: Fraujilan owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Vandili. Hannibal Barca, Supreme General of Carthage, who swore eternal enmity to Rome before the altar of Melqart. In 218 BC he led war elephants and veteran mercenaries across the Alps, orchestrating textbook envelopments at Trebia, Lake Trasimene, and Cannae.
